source: I want to create a game where there are very cute bears that frolic around and I can customise my bear fur colour eye colour ear shape body shape and then romp around an Alaskan forest with my friends

image_prompt.text: Natural shelters - hollows under roots, rock overhangs, caves - that bear players claim and return to
A distinct natural feature visible across the forest so players can navigate by sight and agree where to meet
Open clearings where groups of bears gather and play together rather than pass through
an Alaskan forest - dense evergreens, rock, water and open clearings, with no settlement anywhere in it

notes: No town: an animal sim has no settlement, which is why the open natural world shape exists.
Most of this prompt is avatar customisation - fur colour, eye colour, ear shape, body shape - and none of it is a layout concern. It is recorded but not built.
With my friends implies multiplayer but not a player count; clearing sizes are a guess until that is known.

open_questions.ask: How much forest - one valley you can cross in a minute, or a wide wilderness to roam?
Is there anything to do besides roam together - hunting, raising cubs, seasons - or is hanging out the game?
Should there be a fixed den per player, or open natural shelters anyone can use?

theme: Cute stylised Alaskan wilderness - soft, friendly, oversized natural props

coverage_missing.ask: How big should the forest be?
Is there a loop beyond roaming with friends?
Is customising the bear the main event, in which case a customisation area needs to be a real place in the map?

answers.ask: How much forest - one valley you can cross in a minute, or a wide wilderness to roam?
answers.answer: Use one cozy Alaskan forest valley that players can cross in about a minute; keep it small, social, and easy to explore together.

answers.ask: Is there anything to do besides roam together - hunting, raising cubs, seasons - or is hanging out the game?
answers.answer: Hanging out and romping around with friends is the game; the prompt does not call for hunting, cub raising, or seasonal systems.

answers.ask: Should there be a fixed den per player, or open natural shelters anyone can use?
answers.answer: Use open natural shelters that any bear can use, since the focus is shared forest play rather than personal territory.
